title: Log-concavity of flat arrangement polynomials
summary: We prove log-concavity for the determinant-weighted external semi-activity polynomials of all real flat arrangements, strengthening their known trapezoidality. In fact, we establish a quadratic coefficient inequality that, in rank at least two, implies power concavity with an explicit rank-dependent exponent. The proof uses a new mixed-volume representation of the coefficients and the Alexandrov--Fenchel inequality.
